newsitem.title: USA: FOCUS - Weekly API stocks seen neutral to bearish.
newsitem.headline: FOCUS - Weekly API stocks seen neutral to bearish.

text.p: The weekly oil and products inventory report from the American Petroleum Institute (API), released after futures markets closed Thursday, was neutral-to-bearish, analysts said.
The API report was backed up by data released by the Energy Department a short while later.
Both reports showed fairly large builds in crude oil and distillate stocks last week, when respectively a draw and a modest build were expected by market participants.
"It was significantly contrary to expectations," said Corey Bell, an analyst at Dean Witter in Chicago.
